text: いつも　いそがしそうね…　つかれて　いるんじゃない？

structure.jp: いつも　いそがしそうね…
つかれて　いるんじゃない？

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう put in place of the last い of a describing word means 'looks' or 'seems' that way. いそがしそう = 'looks busy'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.span: つかれて　いるんじゃない
patterns.explanation: んじゃない？ is the spoken form of のではないか: 'isn't it the case that...?', said when you think it is true. つかれて　いるんじゃない？ = 'aren't you tired?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows the state someone is in after something happened. つかれて　いる = 'is tired'.
